items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: The interviewee discusses John Robichaux's band, musicians, and location ('He had a good drummer there too... John Robichaux, John Robichaux'), but does not state that he personally played in the band, met him, or collaborated with him. He refers to him as 'the old man' and describes the band in the
